registration.intro: S MAHI Global Services specializes in bridging the gap between skilled professionals and global opportunities through technology.
registration.p1_text: Our mission is to provide high-quality services to our clients by connecting them with vetted, world-class artisans.
registration.p2_text: Users must provide accurate personal and professional information. False information may lead to account suspension.
registration.p3_text: All registered artisans must provide proof of skill and undergo verification before their profiles become public.
registration.p4_text: Smahi acts as a facilitator and is not directly liable for disputes between clients and artisans, though mediation is provided.
registration.p5_text: Your data is encrypted and secure. We do not sell user data to third-party marketing firms.
registration.p6_text: S. MAHI Global Service reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.
registration.p7_text: Any engagement that violates local laws will be reported to the appropriate authorities.
registration.p8_text: We recommend using the platform for payments to ensure transaction security and valid records.
